mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly describes the ecological significance of Tso Kar in Ladakh?
options: It is a habitat of the Black-necked Crane, and the Tso Kar Wetland Complex was designated a Ramsar site in 2020.
It is a habitat of the Black-necked Crane, and the Tso Kar Wetland Complex was designated a Ramsar site in 2021.
It is a habitat of the Black-necked Crane, but only Startsapuk Tso forms the Ramsar wetland complex.
It is a habitat of the Black-necked Crane, and the Tso Kar Wetland Complex was designated a Ramsar site in 2025.
mcqs.explanation: Tso Kar is a habitat of the Black-necked Crane, and the Tso Kar Wetland Complex—comprising Tso Kar and Startsapuk Tso—was designated a Ramsar site in 2020. The other options alter the Ramsar year or incorrectly exclude Tso Kar from the wetland complex.
